name: N-(2-Carboxyethyl)-N-octyl-beta-alanine
description: N-(2-Carboxyethyl)-N-octyl-beta-alanine (CAS 52663-87-3 ) is an amino acid-derived amphoteric surfactant with chelating functionality. It combines surface-active and metal ion sequestration properties in a single molecule. This unique combination makes it highly relevant to formulators working across cleaning, personal care, and industrial process chemistry. In personal care formulations, it functions as a mild surfactant and conditioning agent. It is frequently used in cleansers and hair care products where compatibility with skin-friendly systems is a priority. Hard surface and industrial cleaners use it to boost wetting performance while sequestering ions. The molecule effectively manages calcium and magnesium ions that typically reduce detergent efficiency in hard water environments. Textile and leather processing operations apply it to improve substrate wetting and control metal ions. It is particularly useful during dyeing or finishing steps to prevent interference. In paper manufacturing, it supports surface modification and process water treatment where both surfactancy and chelation are required. N-(2-Carboxyethyl)-N-octyl-beta-alanine is typically supplied as an aqueous solution, with concentration and active content specified per lot. Technical grade is the standard commercial offering for industrial applications. Higher-purity grades are available for personal care end uses to ensure safety and performance. Buyers should confirm active content, pH range, and counterion form with the supplier when evaluating batches. Careful assessment of these specifications ensures a proper formulation fit for the intended application.
